core_obligations: The cokernel of I/I^2 -> Omega_{B/R} tensor A is Omega_{A/R}; let d be the relative dimension of R -> A at q.
Omega_{A/R, q} is free of rank d over A_q, so the freeness hypothesis forces Omega_{A/R} tensor Lambda to be free of rank d.
Tensoring with Lambda/pi Lambda shows Omega_{A/R} tensor kappa(p) has dimension d.
Flatness of R -> A and the specialization p of q give dim_p(A/R) at least d; equality plus geometric regularity of the fibre field gives smoothness at p by the flat-fibre-smooth lemma.
proof_roadmap: Conormal cokernel; rank count over Lambda; residue field fibre dimension; smoothness conclusion.
